control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dim), then if the line tracker is below 40 % (black) curve left, else if above 88 % (white) curve right, else do nothing; in bright light it does nothing.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called from the start block.
avoidWalls would use obstacles LEFT/RIGHT, driveInTheDark would drive in dim light, stopAtWall would read FRONT, followLine would follow the line.
